video_goal: Demonstrate how to properly set up and use a TheraGun Prime to massage the trapezius muscle.

outline_steps.visual_action: Place the TheraGun Prime with its distinctive triangular handle on a table next to the round Dampener attachment.
Push the stem of the Dampener attachment firmly into the front nozzle of the TheraGun Prime until it sits flush.
Press and hold the center power button on the TheraGun Prime keypad until the white LED speed indicators illuminate and the device vibrates.
Press the down arrow button on the keypad to drop the vibration speed to the lowest LED indicator.
Wrap a hand around the top section of the TheraGun Prime's triangular handle using an overhand grip.
Lift the vibrating device and hover the Dampener attachment just above the right trapezius muscle at the base of the neck.
Gently lower the flat surface of the Dampener attachment so it makes contact with the skin at the base of the right neck.
Slowly glide the vibrating head outward along the ridge of the right trapezius muscle toward the shoulder joint.
Slowly glide the vibrating head back inward along the same muscle path from the shoulder joint to the neck base.
Hold the Dampener attachment completely still on the midpoint of the right trapezius, allowing the vibration to pulse in one spot without applying extra pressure.
Lower the device, switch hands on the triangular handle, and lift it toward the left side of the neck.
Glide the Dampener attachment slowly outward along the left trapezius muscle from the neck base to the left shoulder.
Pull the device away from the body and press the center power button to turn off the LED lights and stop the motor.
